notes: HSK 3 is one page you scroll down, unit after unit, with no sideways swiping. Every unit has the same look: the steamers zig-zag down on top of something high (karst peaks, rice-terrace hills, sandstone pillars, stilt towers), with rope bridges between them. Grass below, a river along one side in some units, and the seasons and the river change gently from one unit into the next
